age.evidence: Adult male C57BL6J mice (n = 66), 8-12 weeks old

dosing.doses_raw: 20 mg/kg, i.p.; subgroup i.c.v. 100 µg/µl, 1 µl
dosing.evidence: single intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of 20 mg/kg, prepared fresh in saline (300 µl, 0.9%) ... A subgroup of mice received an intracerebroventricular (i.c.v.) injection of 5-MeO-DMT (100 µg/µl, 1 µl volume)

handling.evidence: Methods do not mention experimenter handling beyond injection.

group_housing.evidence: housed under a 12 h light/dark cycle, with food and water ad libitum and controlled temperature at 23 °C — cage density not stated

day_night_flipped.evidence: housed under a 12 h light/dark cycle — direction not stated

assays.assay_description: EPM (closed and open arms 33 × 6 cm; center 6 × 6 cm; height: 60 cm). Animals placed in the middle facing a closed arm and video recorded for 10 min. Measures: time in open arms, entries into open arms, plus ethological scoring (protected/unprotected head dips, rearing, return, grooming, fecal boli). Tested 24 h or 5 days after i.p. 5-MeO-DMT/saline, and 5 days after i.c.v. injection in acutely stressed mice.

application_type.evidence: single intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of 20 mg/kg ... A subgroup of mice received an intracerebroventricular (i.c.v.) injection of 5-MeO-DMT

setup_habituation.evidence: Paper does not describe pre-test apparatus habituation.

setup_restrain.evidence: animals were placed in the middle facing a closed arm, and ... video recorded

food_restriction.evidence: Animals tested in EPM; food was not present in the apparatus during the 10-min recording. Home cage food was ad libitum.

water_restriction.evidence: Animals tested in EPM; water was not present in the apparatus during the 10-min recording. Home cage water was ad libitum.

time_to_assay.evidence: Mice treated with 5-MeO-DMT or saline, 24 h or 5 days before ... were tested in the Elevated Plus Maze; stressed cohort tested 5 days after i.c.v.

sample_size.evidence: male mice (n = 24) ... four experimental groups, n = 6 per group ... Mice (n = 11, randomized by raffle) ... 5-MeO-DMT (n = 6) or saline (n = 5)

outcomes.summary: 5-MeO-DMT increased the proportion of entries into the open arms compared to saline at both 24 h and 5 days, and showed a trend toward more time in open arms 5 days post-treatment. In stressed mice (i.c.v.), 5-MeO-DMT pretreatment markedly increased time in open arms (~4.16x). Ethological scoring showed increased unprotected and decreased protected head dips.
outcomes.statistics: Time in OA (5 d): estimate = 0.98539, Z = 1.83972, p = 0.06581; Entries into OA: estimate = 1.18149, Z = 5.21038, p = 1.8845e-7; day effect Z = -4.62789, p = 3.6942e-6; Stressed mice time in OA: estimate = 1.58672, Z = 3.73221, p = 0.00019; head-dip p = 0.032 / 0.018 / 0.016 / 0.001 / 0.007
outcomes.evidence: 5-MeO-DMT to increase the mean ratio of entries into open arms compared to saline (p = 1.8845e-7) ... 5 days after treatment the animals receiving 5-MeO-DMT spent 2.60 times more time in the open arms compared to the saline group ... stressed mice pre-treated with 5-MeO-DMT stayed in open arms 4.16 times longer (p = 0.00019)

B1_num_measures.evidence: time in open arms, entries into open arms, protected head dips, unprotected head dips, rearing, return, grooming, fecal boli

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Analyses based on totals over the 10-min session; no within-session time binning.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or sequence analyses reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Ethological analysis of videos was done manually and blinded, quantifying protected and unprotected head dips, rearing, return, grooming, and fecal boli.

B5_social.evidence: EPM does not target social behaviour; focal mouse tested alone.

B6_cognitive.evidence: EPM measures innate avoidance, no learning required.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Locomotion analyzed by custom centroid-tracking software; ethological scoring done manually.

B8_multivariate.evidence: GLM and beta regression used; no PCA/clustering across behavioural features.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Elevated Plus Maze (closed and open arms 33 × 6 cm; center 6 × 6 cm; height: 60 cm)

E2_shelter.evidence: EPM closed arms are part of apparatus design, not a shelter (definitionally absent).

E3_bedding.evidence: Arenas were cleaned with ethanol 70% between sessions; no bedding mentioned.

E6_spatial.evidence: EPM arms are open-ended extensions of a central platform, not distinct enclosed compartments.

E7_social_context.evidence: Focal mouse tested alone in apparatus.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water in maze during testing.

D1_continuity.evidence: Each animal tested once in EPM (10 min/arena).

D3_recording_days.evidence: Each animal tested on a single recording day (24 h or 5 days post-treatment); independent cohorts.

D5_followup.evidence: Tested 24 h or 5 days after a single 5-MeO-DMT dose.

assays.assay_description: Open field arena 45 × 34 × 16.5 cm; mouse placed in the center (60% of total area) and video recorded for 10 min. Measures: time in central zone, frequency of entries into central zone, trajectory/heatmaps of locomotion. Tested 24 h or 5 days after i.p. 5-MeO-DMT/saline, and 5 days after i.c.v. in acutely stressed mice.

application_type.evidence: single intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of 20 mg/kg ... A subgroup of mice received an intracerebroventricular (i.c.v.) injection of 5-MeO-DMT

setup_habituation.evidence: Paper does not describe pre-test apparatus habituation.

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were placed in the center (60% of total area) and video recorded

food_restriction.evidence: Food was not present in the OF arena during the 10-min recording; home-cage food ad libitum.

water_restriction.evidence: Water was not present in the OF arena during recording; home-cage water ad libitum.

time_to_assay.evidence: Mice tested in the Open Field 24 h or 5 days after treatment; stressed cohort tested 5 days after i.c.v.

sample_size.evidence: Mice (n = 24; 4 experimental groups) ... i.c.v injected (n = 6 5-MeO-DMT, n = 5 saline)

outcomes.summary: 5-MeO-DMT reduced the frequency of entries into the central zone by ~36% compared to saline (no effect on time in centre) — suggesting an anxiogenic-like signal in naive mice. In stressed mice, 5-MeO-DMT pretreatment increased time in the central zone by ~155%, consistent with anxiolytic action under stress.
outcomes.statistics: Time in CZ: estimate = -0.05061, Z = -0.24253, p = 0.80837; Entries CZ: estimate = -0.44569, Z = -4.83081, p = 1.3598e-6; Stressed time in CZ: estimate = 0.93576, Z = 3.30058, p = 0.00096
outcomes.evidence: 5-MeO-DMT treatment to reduce entries to the central zone by 35.96% compared to saline (p = 1.3598e-6) ... pretreatment with 5-MeO-DMT increased duration in the central zone by 154.92% (p = 0.00096)

B1_num_measures.evidence: Quantifying time in the central zone ... frequency of entries into the central zone

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total time/entries over the 10-min session; no within-session time binning.

B4_ethological.evidence: OF measures spatial zone occupancy; no ethological scoring.

B5_social.evidence: Mouse tested alone; no social construct.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Innate anxiety test; no learning required.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Locomotion analysed by custom centroid-tracking software; not pose estimation or ML behaviour classification.

B8_multivariate.evidence: GLM analyses only; no PCA/clustering across behavioural features.

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter in open field arena.

E3_bedding.evidence: Arenas cleaned with ethanol between sessions; no bedding.

E6_spatial.evidence: Open field is a single arena with virtual central zone.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water in arena during testing.

D1_continuity.evidence: Each animal recorded once in OF for 10 min.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Each animal tested on a single OF day (24 h or 5 days post-treatment); independent cohorts.

D5_followup.evidence: Tested 24 h or 5 days after 5-MeO-DMT dose.

judge_notes: Two assays retained: EPM and OFT. Both tested under multiple drug-route (i.p./i.c.v.) and timepoint (24 h, 5 d) conditions; consolidated per rubric (single assay each).

B1 for EPM set to 7+ (score 3): time in OA, entries to OA, protected head dips, unprotected head dips, rearing, return, grooming, fecal boli — 8 distinct measures (matches gptoss; qwen/glm undercounted by collapsing).
D1 set to 'Single session' for both assays: each animal was tested once at a single timepoint; different cohorts at different timepoints do not equal multiple sessions per animal. D3 = 1 accordingly.
Application_type set to 'multiple' for both assays because i.p. and i.c.v. were both used across cohorts within the same assay.
Housing items left not_reported (low confidence): paper mentions 12 h light/dark and ad lib food/water but does not state cage density, handling, light-cycle direction, or enrichment.
Dosing collapsed into one entry with route=multiple to reflect that both i.p. and i.c.v. delivered the same compound.
